sourceText: User approved development of the reviewed playbook promotion worker execution plan, with the final wording correction that V1 should recommend activation rather than automatically promote. User then said: 那开始开发吧.
normalizedOutcome: Implement the M0-M2 playbook promotion foundation so explicit candidate outcome records can be stored and recorded through a host-neutral CLI command without automatic activation or DONE-gate dependence.
acceptanceClaim: A user can run lattice playbook_outcome_record for a candidate playbook and receive non-authoritative, non-gate output while tests prove helped requires concrete exposure plus structured verdict source.
